tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the documentation to understand the BMS admin panel with RBAC, its tech stack (Nuxt 4, Naive UI, TypeORM, SQLite), and core concepts (User → Role → Permission → Guard).

tour.title: Architecture & Data Model
tour.description: Review the system architecture and database schema to understand the Nitro server routes, TypeORM entities, RBAC flow, and entity relationships.

tour.title: Server Infrastructure
tour.description: Examine the server foundation: database connection (SQLite), JWT authentication, password hashing, and middleware for auth/activity logging.

tour.title: Database Entities
tour.description: Review all 9 TypeORM EntitySchema definitions: User, Role, Permission, Guard, and their junction tables (guard_urls, permission_methods, permission_urls, activity_logs, settings).

tour.title: API Layer
tour.description: Explore the Nitro API routes: auth (register, login, profile), CRUD endpoints for users/roles/permissions/guards, activity logs, system logs, settings, and file storage.

tour.title: Services & Business Logic
tour.description: Review the service layer: auth service (JWT, password), CRUD services with pagination/search, RBAC guard/permission checking, and the seeder service for initial data.

tour.title: Shared Types
tour.description: Examine the TypeScript type definitions shared between frontend and backend: User, Role, Permission, Guard, ActivityLog, API response types.

tour.title: Frontend Foundation
tour.description: Understand the Nuxt 4 app setup: app.vue entry, layouts (default with sidebar, auth for login/register), route middleware for JWT validation, and Pinia stores for state management.

tour.title: Frontend Composables
tour.description: Review the Vue composables: useApi (Axios with auth interceptor), useAuthorization (RBAC checks), useDataTable (search/sort/pagination), and feature-specific data composables.

tour.title: UI Components
tour.description: Explore the component architecture: base Button, common components (DataTable, AuthForm, FormField, AccessDeniedAlert), and feature-specific components for users/roles/permissions/guards.

tour.title: Dashboard Pages
tour.description: Review the dashboard pages: main dashboard, user/role/permission/guard management, activity logs, system logs, profile, and settings.

tour.title: Testing & Quality
tour.description: Examine the test infrastructure: unit tests for utils and composables, component tests with @nuxt/test-utils, and E2E tests with Playwright.
